platform: WordPress (Yoast SEO), no e-commerce plugin - /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products returns 404 rest_no_route; no product post type
catalog_endpoint: No product API. Part-number -> model tables are in https://www.infratech.com/manual/reference-manual/ (164 distinct part numbers like 21-3030 = C-2027 SS). Images are per series/color on series pages (/heaters/w-series/ etc.) and /resources/image-downloads/<series>/ (high-res downloads under /downloads/), not per part number.
est_products: 164 part numbers listed in the official reference manual page; retailer bbqoutfitters.com lists 69 Infratech products
sku_format_match: partial - official site uses the same numeric part numbers (NN-NNNN) only inside reference-manual tables, keyed to model names (e.g. 21-3030 = C-2027 SS, 21-4010 = CD-3028 SS, 30-4056 = 6 Relay Panel, 14-4710 = CP-12000-2X); 21-1025 and 21-4280 not on that page. Product pages/images are keyed by model/series, not part number. Retailer Shopify stores use the part number as variant.sku.

sample_tests.note: retailer (Shopify) variant.sku == 21-1025; not on official site by part number. Image filename references W-2527, i.e. a shared W-series image

official reference manual maps 21-4010 = CD-3028 SS

alternatives.name: BBQ Outfitters
alternatives.endpoint: /search/suggest.json?q=<part#>&resources[type]=product ; /products/<handle>.json (variant.sku = Infratech part number); vendor listing /collections/vendors?q=Infratech (69 products)
alternatives.notes: 3/4 heater part numbers found via suggest; 14-4710 not found. Some images shared across sizes (W-2527 image used for W-7512).

alternatives.name: Casual Furniture World
alternatives.notes: Found 21-1025, 21-3030, 21-4010, 21-2330; images are screenshots (Screenshot_2025-10-02_...png) - lower quality. /collections/infratech/products.json returned 503.

recommended_strategy: Hybrid: (1) parse the official reference-manual tables to map every part number -> model/series; (2) for heaters, query bbqoutfitters.com /search/suggest.json?q=<part#> and take the matched product's images (variant.sku == part#); (3) fallback to official series/color images from /resources/image-downloads/<series>/ selected by model series (W, WD, C, CD, SL, Motif) and color suffix; controls/panels (14-xxxx, 30-xxxx) only have generic official images.
blockers: Official site has no per-SKU images or product API; per-part images require retailer data or series-level mapping.
